name: Bohoyo (Spain)
description: Square flag divided vertically into three stripes of blue, white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bohoyo (a marquess's crown on red, a chequy field and a goat on a mount).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially by decree of 28 April 1998 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 98 of 27 May 1998); the flag is a square flag of proportion 1:1 tierced vertically, blue, white with the municipal arms over all, and green.

features.role: Bohoyo arms — crown, chequy and goat
